name: Baldwin Park Winter Wonderland Extravaganza
venue: Mayor Glenda Hood Park, Baldwin Park Village
when_note: Saturday, December 5, 4 to 8 PM, with the lighted parade at 7 PM
paras: The City of Orlando lists the Winter Wonderland Extravaganza at Baldwin Park Village for Saturday, December 5, 2026 from 4 to 8 PM at Mayor Glenda Hood Park on New Broad Street. The city lists the cost as free.
The afternoon includes kids' activities, live holiday performances, local artists, food, stilt walkers, face painting and a chance to take pictures with Santa.
At 7 PM a lighted parade heads down New Broad Street toward Lake Baldwin. After the parade, Santa lights the holiday tree.
The event contact listed by the city is Adam Bailey at Tim Webber Events, 407-719-4488.
tip: Plan to be on New Broad Street before 7 PM if you want a spot for the lighted parade.

name: Holiday Craft Day at Leu Gardens
cost: Included with garden admission: $15 adult, $10 child
paras: Harry P. Leu Gardens hosts Holiday Craft Day on Saturday, December 5, 2026 from 10 AM to 1 PM. Visitors of all ages can join holiday craft activities led by the gardens team.
Crafts include making a snowman ornament, decorating a mini wreath and learning to make snowball slime. All of it is included with regular garden admission.
Admission is $15 for adults and $10 for children. The gardens list their hours as 9 AM to 4 PM, with last entry one hour before closing.
The gardens note that the Historic Leu House Museum is temporarily closed.
tip: Craft Day runs only 10 AM to 1 PM, so arrive early to fit in all three crafts.
